label: ISO 27001
scope_note: 30 ISMS assessment units (clauses 4–10) and 93 Annex A controls. Clauses cannot be excluded for conformity. Annex A selection requires risk-based SoA justification. Original implementation prompts, not a reproduction of ISO text or a certification opinion.

requirements.title: Context and external issues
requirements.guidance: Record relevant business conditions and whether climate change affects the ISMS.
requirements.evidence_guidance: Context register and documented climate relevance decision.
requirements.source_cadence: Use the clause-specific planning or change trigger. ISO does not prescribe a universal annual or quarterly Review interval.

requirements.title: Stakeholder obligations
requirements.guidance: Identify relevant parties, their obligations and which the ISMS addresses, including relevant climate concerns.
requirements.evidence_guidance: Interested-party register with obligation owners.
requirements.source_cadence: Use the clause-specific planning or change trigger. ISO does not prescribe a universal annual or quarterly Review interval.

review_plans.reason: Shared operational review supporting the cited ISO references; cadence is an Omnisciente recommendation.
